newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-TIMBERWOLVES' MITCHELL, ROCKETS' WILLIS FINED.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-TIMBERWOLVES' MITCHELL, ROCKETS' WILLIS FINED.

text.p: The NBA on Monday fined forwards Sam Mitchell of the Minnesota Timberwolves and Kevin Willis of the Houston Rockets for their actions during Saturday's playoff game at Houston.
Mitchell was fined $10,000 by the league based on the severity of a flagrant foul he committed against Willis with 9:25 left in the fourth quarter of Houston's 96-84 victory.
Mitchell clobbered Willis with a swinging right forearm and was ejected following the incident. The ejection carries an additional automatic $1,000 fine.
Willis was fined $7,500 for flagrantly elbowing Mitchell in the head with 1:15 remaining in the first quarter.
The Rockets lead the best-of-five series 2-0. Game Three is Tuesday in Minnesota.
